A 1:1 square character asset sheet, evenly lit with flat uniform lighting and no directional light source, on a solid light gray background free from any shadows, gradients, textures, patterns, text, or seals.

Upper section, three full-body standing views arranged in a horizontal row with equal spacing:  
Left view — the character's entire body rotated 45 degrees to the right as a unified whole, presenting the left-front side to the viewer, with the head turned back to face the camera and eyes looking directly at the viewer. The waist sash faces the right-front, the left shoulder is closer to the viewer and the right shoulder is farther away. She wears a flowing traditional Chinese-style hanfu with intricate embroidery of peony flowers in gold and red threads. The outer robe is a soft pastel pink, layered over a white inner garment with subtle floral patterns. The wide sleeves drape elegantly, and the waist is adorned with a jade belt featuring tassels. Her skirt is floor-length, pleated, and transitions from pink to pale lavender. She wears embroidered silk shoes with floral motifs. Hands empty at the sides, both feet fully visible.  
Center view — the character's entire body rotated 45 degrees to the left as a unified whole, presenting the right-front side to the viewer, with the head turned back to face the camera and eyes looking directly at the viewer. The waist sash faces the left-front, the right shoulder is closer to the viewer and the left shoulder is farther away. The same hanfu details are visible, showcasing the elegant drape of the fabric and the intricate embroidery at the hem. Hands empty at the sides, both feet fully visible.  
Right view — rear view from directly behind, showing the back of the head, hairstyle from behind, back of the garment, rear of the waist sash, and heel of the shoes. The flowing outer robe reveals the layered structure of the hanfu, with embroidery extending along the back hemline. Both feet fully visible.

Lower section, four face close-ups arranged in a horizontal row with equal spacing, all in straight frontal view with upright neck, eyes looking directly at the camera, complete hair crown and headpiece visible with space above:  
Close-up 1 — calm neutral expression, lips naturally closed, no smile, relaxed facial muscles.  
Close-up 2 — gentle closed-lip smile, corners of the mouth slightly raised, no teeth visible, neck straight and upright.  
Close-up 3 — open smile showing upper row of teeth, approximately six to eight teeth visible.  
Close-up 4 — surprised expression with mouth open in a round shape, tongue and both rows of teeth visible.

The character is a beautiful young woman in her early 20s, with delicate facial features, smooth fair skin, and a slender build. Her hairstyle is a traditional Chinese updo with intricate braids and a hairpin adorned with jade and pearls. Her long black hair cascades down in a partially loose style, framing her face. Subtle makeup highlights her natural beauty, with a soft pink blush, red lips, and defined yet delicate eyebrows. Accessories include jade earrings and a silk ribbon tied around her wrist.

All seven modules depict the exact same character with identical clothing, headpiece, hairstyle, makeup, and accessories. EXACTLY 3 full-body views in the upper row, EXACTLY 4 face close-ups in the lower row. Ultra-detailed, sharp focus, 8K resolution, high clarity, intricate details.
